$comment: Cycle P69 round 1 (lane `lm`): D-C-CONSTANT-AGGREGATE-MEMBER-READ-WITHOUT-ITS-INITIALIZERS-OPERATOR, D-C-GENERIC-SELECTION-BEFORE-THE-EXPRESSION-PASS-SELECTS-DEFAULT, D-HIR-BRACE-PEEL-TAKES-AN-OPERATORS-OPERAND-FOR-THE-ELEMENT and D-HIR-WHOLE-STRUCTURE-BRACE-ELEMENT-IS-PLACED-BY-TYPE-STAMPS — a constant, and a brace element, is read as it was written. The member of a constant aggregate has the value of its initializer, operator included (C 6.7.9p11): a member initialized by `-5`, `!0`, `~0u`, `sizeof K`, `-K`, `-h.b` was read as the OPERAND (5, 0, 0, 3, 3, 9) wherever the compiler wanted the member as a constant, and a condition on it deleted the code after its `if`, its `while`, its `for` and its `do` — the program died of an illegal instruction. A generic selection in an enumerator, an array bound and a bit-field width selects by its controlling expression's type (6.5.1.1p3), where `default` used to be selected for a controlling literal. An operator's result is an ELEMENT of a braced character array, never the string under the operator (`char s[] = { *"abc", 'z' };` was refused by an internal verifier). A whole structure written as an index, a dereference, a conditional, a comma expression or a call initializes the structure it meets WHOLE (6.7.9p13) — it used to be taken for the initializer of that structure's first member, and refused. exit 42 = every check right; any other exit code names the first check that failed (the table in main.c).
